closing: A clean result may describe the rule more clearly than it describes the world.

beats.say: Trurl builds four villages in a box, with a few fighters among them. Klapaucius is handed a strike, and a gift of care.
First, strikes alone. Each strike removes the fighters near it, and harms everyone around them.

acts.fn: const F = V.villagers.filter(v => v.fighter()); return F.length ? [[F[0].x, F[0].y]] : [];

beats.say: Anger turns neighbours into fighters faster than the strikes can remove them.

acts.fn: const F = V.villagers.filter(v => v.fighter()); return F.length ? [[F[0].x, F[0].y]] : [];

beats.say: Again, from the start. Care for every village first. Then strike only where the fighters are.

acts.fn: const F = V.villagers.filter(v => v.fighter()); const out = []; for (const f of F) { if (out.every(o => Math.hypot(o[0] - f.x, o[1] - f.y) > 60)) out.push([f.x, f.y]); if (out.length === 3) break; } return out;

beats.say: The insurgency ends, and most of the villagers lean toward the state.

acts.fn: const F = V.villagers.filter(v => v.fighter()); const out = []; for (const f of F) { if (out.every(o => Math.hypot(o[0] - f.x, o[1] - f.y) > 60)) out.push([f.x, f.y]); if (out.length === 3) break; } return out;

beats.say: Every strike recruited someone. The care decided who.
